# Rule 1- Be Nice To People [bold]Everyone is ultimately here to have fun[/bold]. Use your better judgment in your behavior, and don't do anything with the express goal or disproportionate effect of negatively affecting other players and their experiences.
Interpersonal conflict is at the core of the game and this server's format, but these fictional conflicts should not cross the line into the real world. Keep all arguments IC, and do not use OOC spaces to resolve IC issues.
If you have problems with another player's conduct or with the server, use the AHelp menu to inform the admins, and/or reach out to involved parties privately via Discord. Do not use OOC spaces to confront players for their conduct, to complain about other players, or to argue.
[bold]Harassment or toxic behavior will not be tolerated[/bold]. Any of the following will result in immediate disciplinary action. - [bold]Discrimination[/bold] (including but not limited to slurs, racism/sexism, hate speech, and bigotry). There is a zero-tolerance policy for discrimination OOC and any such cases will result in an immediate ban. IC discriminatory behavior should be sparing at best. Refer to [textlink="Rule 3" link="RuleSpL3"] for more. - [bold]Metagrudging[/bold] (unfairly targeting another player between rounds without IC justification). OOC relations should not influence how you play the game, and OOC conflicts are not to seep into IC interactions. - [bold]Malding[/bold] (complaining about IC events or about other players in OOC channels, or bringing OOC issues into roleplay). This encompasses any and all complaints about the server or any of its players, as well as OOC arguments with other players.
OOC channels are a privilege, not an entitlement. They are not to be used to vent frustrations or start arguments.
